summary.text: Bob Martinson is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 35 since December 1, 2000 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Martinson attended Bismarck State College and earned a B.S. from the University of Mary, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes working as an independent landman, and he reached the rank of lieutenant colonel in the North Dakota Army Reserve National Guard.
Ballotpedia also states that he served in the House from 1973 to 1997.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignment as the Appropriations - Education and Environment Committee.
